title: Customer preference requests across seating, interface, and design
summary: This topic is a broad set of customer preference statements about seat support, display and interface layout, controls, storage, styling, and other feature wishes rather than a single coherent issue.

positive.summary: The positive review expresses preference for an older washer spray layout over the current setup.

negative.summary: The negative review criticizes the current screen placement and size as awkward and unnecessarily large.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly state feature or design preferences without clear praise or dissatisfaction, including requests about side bolsters, preconditioning duration, interface text size, buttons, storage layout, steering-wheel texture, and vehicle proportions.

limitations: Most examples are classified as undetermined, so the topic provides limited clear sentiment evidence.
This cluster mixes many unrelated preference statements across seating, software, controls, interior layout, and exterior design rather than one specific product attribute.
The keyword 'side bolsters' appears in only part of the sample, so it should not be treated as the sole focus of the topic.
